name: RailDraw Signalling v1.6.0
releaseNotes:
• Redesigned Insignia & Liquid Morph Launch: Sleeker Vande Bharat S&T logo with a smooth orb-to-squircle morph transition
• 16 New Signal & Underground Cable Symbols (86 Total): Theatre Route Indicators, Distant ('P' Marker), IBS ('IB' Marker), CLS Repeaters ('R' Marker), Signal Gantries, Stop Boards, Underground Cable Trenches, HDD Bores, HDPE/RCC Duct Banks, Draw Pits, Joint Pits, CT Racks, Concrete Troughs, Under-Track Crossings (UTX), OFC Splice Chambers, and Underground Earth Electrode Pits
• Play Store-Style In-App Updater: Direct in-app APK download with live MB/percentage progress and automatic system installer launch
